reused_component.treatment: Original 12 path geometries preserved, recoloured from source palette to poster ink/gold/red; added manually constructed white backing silhouette for use on the gold field.

excluded_reuse.Davidson_poster: Its stacked EXPO / three-ring 86 symbol differs from the Pavilion flag badge. No Davidson art is used in the reconstruction.
excluded_reuse.crest_wordmark: PofBC crest WORDMARK is flared sans (Optima-like) and differs from the poster serif ligature. Not used.

limitations: Flag vectors from PofBC reuse an established reconstruction, not a historical production master. The 1986 impression is close but not proven identical in every wave or ray.
Footer marks are tailored for legibility at small poster size; no numerical identity claim.
Font substitutions in small logo captions are disclosed; original typefaces not verified.
